title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Socio WP…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WP Socio WP Telegram Widget and Join Link up to version 2.2.16. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of the affected web application.
